name_en: Workers' compensation PTSD coverage for first responders
name_zh: 工伤赔偿的创伤后应激推定
definition_en: State workers' compensation law covering post-traumatic stress disorder in first responders (police, firefighters, EMS/paramedics, sometimes dispatchers) without an accompanying physical injury, via a presumption or explicit mental-mental coverage; year the law was signed.
definition_zh: 州工伤赔偿法规定警察、消防员、急救人员（部分含调度员）所患创伤后应激障碍无需伴随身体伤害即可获赔，方式为法律推定或明确的精神性损伤覆盖；年份为法案签署年。
year_basis: Year the first law explicitly covering PTSD/mental injury of first responders without physical injury was SIGNED. Peer-support/training-only laws and general all-worker mental-mental coverage excluded.
